fields.System.Title: INT-401 — Open work by zone
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to see outstanding work by area right now, so that I can move
staff before a bottleneck costs us the cut-off.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the view, then it shows open pick, putaway, replenishment, and count tasks
  • grouped by zone.
  • - Given each group, then it shows count, oldest task age, and how many are assigned
  • versus unassigned.
  • - Given tasks tied to a wave with an imminent cut-off, then they are highlighted.
  • - Given the view, then it refreshes frequently enough to act on within a shift.
  • - Given an unassigned task older than a threshold, then it is flagged.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, all task modules |
| Tables | pick_task, putaway_task, replen_task, count_task |
| Risks | Query across four task tables becoming slow at peak |
| Tests | integration |
